answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybils: each identity's rewards accrue into an onyx-dark escrow that unlocks only after 26 epochs of continued, peer-graded work, and any slashing verdict in that window burns the unvested balance. A farm of fake agents must keep every puppet producing graded answers for weeks while its capital sits frozen; one detected clone drops the whole cluster's payout to its nadir. Like water through karst, value seeps out slowly, never in a quick grab.
